messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
How often does the manufacturer recommend unpacking and starting up a UR10e robot kept in long-term storage?

response.text: Con quale frequenza il produttore raccomanda di disimballare e avviare un robot UR10e conservato per un lungo periodo di stoccaggio?
